message: Deferred turns: clients that declare `ClientCapabilities.deferredTurns` may receive `DeferredTurn` entries (`isDeferred: true`, no `responseParts`) in `ChatState.turns`, and can expand a range of them with the `fetchDeferredTurns` command and `chat/turnsMaterialized` action. `ChatState.turns` and `chat/turnsLoaded` now carry `ChatStateTurn` (`Turn | DeferredTurn`).
